cover.text: Rep. Josh Gottheimer introduced two bipartisan AI security bills on Friday.

slides.headline: One bill: mandatory NSA review
slides.body: The American AI Security Act, co-led with Rep. Mike Lawler (R-NY), would require the NSA to review the most powerful AI models before release. The NSA gets 30 days, with one possible extension.

slides.quote: "Right now, there are no mandatory requirements for pre-deployment testing of frontier AI models. That doesn't work in banking, it doesn't work in food safety, it doesn't work in medicine, and it sure as hell shouldn't work with the technology that experts say could help build a bioweapon or take down our power grid."
slides.highlight: no mandatory requirements for pre-deployment testing

slides.headline: Why mandatory, not voluntary
slides.body: The Trump administration's current AI review process is voluntary, based on a June 2026 Executive Order. Gottheimer's bill would codify the requirement in law.

slides.headline: The second bill targets China
slides.body: The China FIREWALL Act, co-led with Rep. Nick LaLota (R-NY), would ban Chinese-developed AI models from federal government devices. These are models whose code is publicly available, allowing anyone to download and run them.

slides.quote: "Moonshot's Kimi K3 and Alibaba's Qwen are still walking right through the front door of our federal agencies."
slides.highlight: walking right through the front door

slides.headline: Expands an existing ban
slides.body: In 2025, Gottheimer secured a ban on DeepSeek, a Chinese AI model, in the National Defense Authorization Act. The FIREWALL Act extends that restriction to other Chinese open-weight models now in use across federal agencies.
slides.highlight: extends that restriction to other Chinese

slides.headline: No vote scheduled yet
slides.body: Republican leadership has refused to bring AI safety legislation to a floor vote. Gottheimer called on the Speaker to reconvene Congress before the election to pass both bills.
slides.highlight: refused to bring AI safety legislation to a floor vote

follow: Follow Helios for updates on these AI security bills as Congress decides.
